source: issue #1082 wiring (baseline measured with: godot4 --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gexit)
note:
Ratchet ceiling for the GUT CI gate (scripts/gut_baseline_gate.py). Ratchet failing DOWN as per-suite fix PRs land — never raise it without team sign-off. Counts are the 'Tests/Passing Tests/Failing Tests/Risky-Pending' summary lines from the GUT log; recorded against a dev machine with the local Nakama stack up, so first live CI run may need a one-time recount (docs/testing/GUT_TRIAGE_2026-08-17.md has the reproduction commands).

Reconciliation for issue #1361 (PR #1364, Shape A): the 5 test stubs listed under pending_stubs_conversion were added since the original baseline; their bodies had zero assertions, so GUT reported them as Risky: 'Did not assert'. They inflated the per-PR failing-test count and tripped the gate on every PR. Each was converted to pending() with an explicit 'Stub: ... issue #1082' reason referencing the unblock work. The 'failing' low-water mark stayed at 49 (no ratchet-up); the gate (scripts/gut_baseline_gate.py) allows up to baseline + tolerance (= 54) failing tests to absorb minor drift between baseline captures.

Follow-up reconciliation (this PR, issue #1361-ext): the 28 tests under pending_conversions_issue_1361_followup were converted to pending() because each one asserts an API surface that does NOT exist in the production code under test (per the contract of #1361 we cannot modify production Godot code in `frontend/`, `scenes/`, or `addons/` outside `addons/gut`). Brief justification per group:
  - 10 CoverageTracker tests: the `GutCoverageTracker` autoload is only registered when GUT is invoked with --coverage mode (addons/gut/coverage/coverage_pre_run.gd hooks). The basic `local-godot-tests.sh --gut` invocation does NOT register it, so `TrackerHelper.get_tracker_instance()` returns null and every test fails with 'GutCoverageTracker autoload not found'. The coverage job that DOES register the autoload is `.github/workflows/coverage.yml`'s `godot-coverage` job, where these tests still pass (verified locally with `godot4 --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gcoverage -gexit`).
  - 7 ThemeManager tests: the suite was written against an older string-based API (`set_theme('light'|'dark'|'gilded')` / `get_theme_name()`) that production no longer exposes; the production API is the `ThemeMode` enum (LIGHT/DARK) via `set_theme_mode()` / `get_theme_mode()`. No 'gilded' theme exists in production.
  - 4 cross_manager_integration tests: assign `game_mgr.network_manager`, `gear_mgr._player_gear`, `season_mgr.current_season`, `player_mgr._currency` / `_gems` — production does not expose any of these as writable attributes.
  - 4 network_combat_integration tests: assume attributes/methods (`is_server_connected`, `_join_queue`, `current_match_state`, `_current_level`) that are not part of the shipped API.
  - 1 each for test_object_pool_has_acquire_release, test_vfx_manager.gd::test_internal_methods_exist, test_auto_aim_manager_has_targeting_methods, test_player_stats_manager.gd::test_stats_updated_signal: production simply does not expose the methods/attributes being asserted.

The 'failing' low-water mark was ratcheted DOWN from 49 to 14 (test count ratcheted from 582 to 553) reflecting the actual current local failure count. CI is expected to add up to ~2 tests of flakiness (e.g. timing-sensitive Godot 4.6 behaviour), so baseline + tolerance (= 19) still gives a 5-test buffer for CI drift while honouring the ratchet-down contract from issue #894.
